jobs.title: Workforce Management Planning Analyst [Remote, WFH]
jobs.description: What you’ll do Forecasting & Capacity Forecast call, case, and task volumes across channels, adjusting for seasonality, campaigns, and business events. Translate forecasts into staffing requirements and capacity plans that balance service performance, utilization, and cost. Compare forecasts against actuals, explain variance, and refine assumptions to improve accuracy over time. Scheduling & Allocation Build and maintain schedules, shifts, and rotations that meet coverage needs within business constraints. Plan around training, PTO, and project time while keeping scheduling fair and transparent for agents. Allocate staff across queues and skills to meet service goals efficiently. Intraday Management Monitor real-time queues, adherence, and service levels across channels. Take tactical action when conditions change, such as re-queuing, shift adjustments, or overtime, weighing service, cost, and agent impact. Communicate status, interventions, and escalations clearly and quickly to operations partners. Analytics & Recommendations Track utilization, shrinkage, adherence, and forecast accuracy to surface trends and improvement opportunities. Deliver clear reporting and insights that inform headcount planning, budgeting, and operational decisions. Diagnose root causes of performance gaps and propose practical, system-aware improvements. Stakeholder Partnership Partner with Operations, HR, Training, and Finance to keep planning assumptions and cadences aligned. Document assumptions, flag changes early, and maintain reliable planning records others depend on. Contribute to WFM processes and team initiatives that improve how we work.
